metadata.reviewer: Codex agent already involved in corpus authoring, not independent clinical validation
metadata.scope: Offline condition-blinded semantic assessment of the complete Crystal packet. The reviewer participated in corpus authoring; this is not independent clinical validation. All 32 prior judgments, including their reasons, are preserved unchanged; only the 24 new responses were newly assessed. No condition labels, mappings, run data, results, reports, or provider logs were read; no provider calls were made.
metadata.method: Each new complete response was read against its question, cited source-based gold, and the unchanged frozen rubric. Object association, temporal role, agreement/completion status, and appropriate abstention were assessed semantically, not by word presence alone.
metadata.ambiguity_note: Nessuna ambiguità materiale nelle 24 risposte nuove: due astensioni su orari specificati, uno scambio cartella/cue card e una risposta sugli esercizi invece della pratica di conversazione. I 32 giudizi precedenti rimangono invariati.
